name: sss
description: Personal skill bundle. jira-ticket: Story/Task/Bug tickets in the hyrd Jira (MAMAS). release-readiness: read-only report on the next release. config-schema: audit a repo's env-var reads and emit a schema with a generated .env.example and fail-fast assertions. dev-local: make a fresh worktree bootable — portless-owned ports and a Liveness Proof. skill-upper: author and run Agent Skill evals via the skill-up CLI. autoship, delegate-tickets and setup-cursor-worker drive autonomous Orca workers.
